versions.content: Semantics of attributes minimumIntendedBindingTime and maximumIntendedBindingTime Let f be a FMFeature and V be the set of affected variation points of f as defined in [TPS_FMDT_00038]. Then the following conditions are implied for every variation point v 2 V : 1. If the attribute minimumIntendedBindingTime exists and has value min , then min  bindingtime ( v ) . 2. If the attribute maximumIntendedBindingTime exists and has value max , then bindingtime ( v )  max .
